result.title: Mesh2Shell Neural Operator for Inverse Shape Optimization
result.summary: Physics-driven design seeks high-performing geometries, which need not conform to a learned shape category. Parametric and latent-space approaches facilitate surrogate-based optimization, but restrict deformations to prescribed shape families or learned decoders. We introduce the Mesh-to-Shell Neural Operator (M2S-NO) as the mesh-to-shell component of a category-agnostic inverse shape optimization framework. We separate the explicit mesh used for design from the volumetric representation used for physics prediction. M2S-NO maps oriented surface samples to a surface-centered shell representation, such as TruncatedSDF or HeatSDF. A separate problem-specific PDE neural operator (PDE-NO) maps this representation to physical fields. Objective gradients update mesh vertices through both operators, without a latent shape decoder. Preconditioning and remeshing support free-form deformation, while fixed interfaces are controlled directly on the mesh. Optional shell-space proposals enable topology changes. We evaluate geometric matching, jet-engine brackets, and neutron moderators, with independent FEM and OpenMC evaluation. Relative to the best training designs, M2S-NO reduces maximum bracket displacement by 14.3% and increases neutron-sensor current by 13.8%. Optimization also succeeds from an out-of-distribution bracket initialization, demonstrating the framework's geometric flexibility.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Mesh2Shell 神经算子（M2S-NO），把带方向的表面采样映射为 TruncatedSDF、HeatSDF 等以表面为中心的壳层表示，再由任务专用 PDE 神经算子预测物理场，目标梯度经两个算子回传更新网格顶点，从而在不用 latent 形状解码器的条件下做类别无关的自由形状逆向优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 以 SDF 类隐式壳层承载几何、并与下游预测算子显式分离，或可供核查 LVR 中几何与任务必要信息的内部编码方式、以及不经解码器的梯度分配线索；与 VLM 推理本身无直接关联，需较多核查。
